Alex Baena.note: For Baena, the foundation is reading the next phase before the space fully opens. Look first at how he adjusts his position early enough to make the difficult action look simple. Beyond that, watch how he serves corners and free kicks into the attacking area.
Alex Baena.noteZh: 看Álex Baena的作用，关键是空当完全出现前读懂下一阶段。他会提前调整位置，让困难处理看起来简单。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会把角球和任意球送入进攻区域。

Alex Grimaldo.note: Watch Grimaldo for choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. The clearest example is how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. A separate clue is how Grimaldo looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Alex Grimaldo.noteZh: 观察Álex Grimaldo时，可以先看从后场加入进攻的启动时机。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。另一个比赛细节是他会在传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Aymeric Laporte.note: What separates Laporte is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. Laporte plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. At another point, he moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Aymeric Laporte.noteZh: 看Aymeric Laporte的作用，关键是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会迎向落下的球，在进攻者站稳前参与争抢。

Borja Iglesias.note: Iglesias's signature is giving centre-backs a physical problem they cannot ignore. Watch how he pins a defender and creates room for the next runner. At another point in the move, he meets the pass without adding an extra touch.
Borja Iglesias.noteZh: Borja Iglesias的比赛建立在让中后卫无法忽视的身体支点作用之上。首先看他如何牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。另一个方面是他会迎球直接完成射门，不增加调整触球。

Dani Olmo.note: The key to Olmo is receiving in tight spaces with his next action already planned. He opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward. Elsewhere in the game, Olmo arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Dani Olmo.noteZh: Dani Olmo的比赛建立在狭小空间接球前就想好下一步之上。首先看他如何在第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。另一个方面是他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

David Raya.note: Watch Raya for command of the crowded space around goal. The clearest example is how he attacks the cross at the highest point he can control before traffic closes. Also notice how Raya chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
David Raya.noteZh: David Raya最鲜明的特点是掌控门前拥挤空间的能力。一个直接线索是他会在人群合拢前迎向传中，并在最高可控点处理来球。另一个独立细节是他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Eric Garcia.summary: Eric García is a Spain centre-back from Barcelona who gives the national team build-up passing, tactical coverage, and calm defending.
Eric Garcia.note: García stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. A different detail is how García plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Eric Garcia.noteZh: 观察Eric García时，可以先看先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。另一个比赛细节是他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Fabian Ruiz.note: For Ruiz, the foundation is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. Look first at how he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. Separately, look at how he shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Fabian Ruiz.noteZh: 观察Fabián Ruiz时，可以先看压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。另一个比赛细节是他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Ferran Torres.note: For Torres, the foundation is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. Look first at how he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. Beyond the first action, he moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Ferran Torres.noteZh: 看Ferran Torres的作用，关键是等防守者注意力转移后再启动。他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Gavi.note: What separates Gavi is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. Gavi angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. At another point, he protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Gavi.noteZh: Gavi的优势在于带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。最直接的表现是他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。另一个值得观察的细节是他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Joan Garcia.note: The key to García is staying balanced until the shot reveals its direction. He keeps his feet active and makes the save with the fewest movements. In another phase, García chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Joan Garcia.noteZh: Joan García的比赛建立在射门方向明确前保持身体平衡之上。首先看他如何保持脚下轻快，用最少动作完成扑救。另一个方面是他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Lamine Yamal.note: What separates Yamal is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. Yamal draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. Away from that action, he changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Lamine Yamal.noteZh: Lamine Yamal的比赛建立在比防线早一步看到决定性的传球之上。首先看他如何先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。另一个方面是他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Marc Cucurella.note: Cucurella stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. Also look at how Cucurella turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Marc Cucurella.noteZh: Marc Cucurella的优势在于选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。最直接的表现是他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。另一个值得观察的细节是他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Marc Pubill.note: Pubill's signature is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. Watch how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He also checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives.
Marc Pubill.noteZh: 从后场加入进攻的启动时机构成Marc Pubill踢法的核心。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。除此之外，值得留意他会在最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。

Marcos Llorente.note: Watch Llorente for waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. The clearest example is how he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. A separate clue is how Llorente moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Marcos Llorente.noteZh: Marcos Llorente最鲜明的特点是等防守者注意力转移后再启动。一个直接线索是他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。另一个独立细节是他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Martin Zubimendi.note: For Zubimendi, the foundation is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. Look first at how he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. A separate point is how he holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Martin Zubimendi.noteZh: Martín Zubimendi的优势在于压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。最直接的表现是他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。另一个值得观察的细节是他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Mikel Merino.note: The key to Merino is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. Elsewhere in the game, Merino meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Mikel Merino.noteZh: 最能体现Mikel Merino特点的是等防守者注意力转移后再启动。这一点直接体现在他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。除此之外，他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Mikel Oyarzabal.note: Oyarzabal stands out for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He shifts onto his left foot and shoots with little backlift. Another aspect is how Oyarzabal arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Mikel Oyarzabal.noteZh: 防线重组前制造干净射门是理解Mikel Oyarzabal踢法的关键。先看他如何把球调整到左脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。到了另一个比赛环节，他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Nico Williams.note: The key to Williams is explosive speed once open grass appears. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. One more thing to notice is how Williams pulls the ball back from near the end line toward a supporting runner.
Nico Williams.noteZh: 看到空当后的爆发速度是理解Nico Williams踢法的关键。先看他如何等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。到了另一个比赛环节，他会接近底线后把球回传给后排接应的队友。

Pau Cubarsi.note: Cubarsí stands out for moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. Also look at how Cubarsí waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Pau Cubarsi.noteZh: Pau Cubarsí最鲜明的特点是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。一个直接线索是他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。另一个独立细节是他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Pedri.note: Pedri's signature is receiving in tight spaces with his next action already planned. Watch how he opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward. Another detail is how he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Pedri.noteZh: 观察Pedri时，可以先看狭小空间接球前就想好下一步。他会在第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。另一个比赛细节是他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Pedro Porro.note: Watch Porro for delivering the ball without needing much space. The clearest example is how he looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. Also watch how Porro angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Pedro Porro.noteZh: 最能体现Pedro Porro特点的是很小空间里也能送出传中的能力。这一点直接体现在他会在传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。除此之外，他也会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Rodri.note: Rodri's signature is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. Watch how he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. Another detail is how he takes the first available forward lane before it closes.
Rodri.noteZh: 最能体现Rodri特点的是压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。这一点直接体现在他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。除此之外，他也会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。

Unai Simon.note: What separates Simón is starting high enough to protect the space behind his defense. Simón leaves his line early when a through ball escapes the back line. A separate detail appears when he chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Unai Simon.noteZh: 最能体现Unai Simón特点的是用靠前站位保护后防身后空间。这一点直接体现在他会在直塞球越过后防时及时出击。除此之外，他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Victor Munoz.note: What separates Muñoz is explosive speed once open grass appears. Muñoz changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. At another point, he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Victor Munoz.noteZh: Víctor Muñoz最鲜明的特点是看到空当后的爆发速度。一个直接线索是他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。另一个独立细节是他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Yeremy Pino.note: Watch Pino for pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. The clearest example is how he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. Also watch how Pino moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Yeremy Pino.noteZh: 理解Yéremy Pino，要先看带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。
